Create exactly EIGHT full-body frames arranged in a perfectly regular FOUR-column TWO-row grid. Canvas 2048x1024, each cell 512x512. Read frames left-to-right top row then bottom row. Every cell contains exactly one complete character, same size, character about 400 pixels tall including head curl. Align face center horizontally at local x=240, neutral shoe baseline local y=455, leave broad transparent margins. Frame1 neutral open eyes smile; 2 slight inhale rising shoulders; 3 full inhale and relaxed open eyes; 4 half-closed eyelids; 5 fully closed smiling eyelids; 6 half-open eyelids; 7 open eyes and breathing settles; 8 pose almost matches frame1 ready to loop. Arms stay relaxed beside apron. Body motion minimal; subtly swaying hair and whale tail.
